Care Sheet: Tropical Guppies

Guppies need a water temperature between 24 and 27 degrees Celsius, so a heater is essential.

Feed them small amounts twice a day; uneaten food should be removed after five minutes.

Change about a quarter of the water every week.

Guppies are peaceful and can be kept with other small fish, but not with larger fish that may eat them.
